nativeRoute: DeviceCloudAuthClient Casdoor SSO / operating-system refresh credential

loginFlow.steps: 优先 owner CLI 的同进程 session、系统 keyring refresh；缺失由 CLI 读取 /auth/cli/config，仅一个进程打开用户授权浏览器，校验 loopback state 后 POST /auth/cli/token。缺少安全 keyring 直接失败。
loginFlow.authorization: Login, token creation/rotation/revocation and business writes require the current task scope; this discovery performs none.

tokenMechanism: Access token 仅内存；refresh token 只存系统 keyring/Windows Credential Manager，轮换原地更新；不降级明文。PAT 是另一候选自动化链，不擅自切换。
subjectPermission: GET /auth/userinfo 校验 email；服务端签名/iss/aud/exp 验证；GraphQL 资源容量与 Job 权限分别核验；GitLab 用例仓只读权限另验证。
expiryRevoke: POST /auth/cli/refresh 复用 refresh；撤销/CLI logout 尚需确认可支持版本，不虚构命令。

versionPolicy.rule: Candidate source and published contracts do not establish deployed compatibility. Verify the target instance version and read-only supported capabilities before enabling an adapter.

verification.scope: Read-only documentation/repository discovery; no login, token issuance, credential inspection or business API execution.
